capabilities.description: Exact finite reaction-indexed integer hyperflows with input/output exchange and a thin coercion bridge to the authenticated real CRN stoichiometric matrix.
laws: casting the exact balance to real scalars agrees with the reused stoichiometricMatrix mulVec
for every species, exact reaction change plus input exchange minus output exchange is zero
reaction and exchange flows are nonnegative integers

capabilities.description: A derivative and Jacobian layer over the authenticated Oregonator model, flux, and vectorField API.
laws: equilibrium means the reused Oregonator vectorField vanishes
parameter/state derivative splitting uses only the admitted Physlib FDerivCurry adapter
the Jacobian represents that derivative without rescaling the ODE
the derivative is the Mathlib Frechet derivative of the reused vector field
source_refs: BIOMODELS-BIOMD0000000040:Reaction1–Reaction5 kinetic laws and internal vector-field identity

capabilities.description: An exact finite-dimensional local imaginary-eigenpair crossing witness, deliberately named and scoped below a Hopf theorem and separated from periodic-orbit existence.
laws: an open parameter neighborhood containing the critical parameter carries a nonzero complex eigenvector branch satisfying the real Jacobian eigenpair equation at every parameter in that neighborhood
the certificate asserts only a local imaginary-eigenpair crossing, not eigenvalue simplicity, spectral isolation, a Hopf bifurcation, or periodic-orbit existence
the certified eigenvalue branch has nonzero real-part derivative at the critical parameter
the critical eigenvalue is purely imaginary with strictly positive frequency

capabilities.description: A pure dynamical-system certificate carrying all evidence required for deterministic oscillation, independent of any numerical trace.
laws: a numerical trajectory alone is not a certificate
at every time the trajectory derivative equals the supplied vector field
the period is strictly positive
the trajectory is nonconstant
the trajectory is periodic with that period

capabilities.description: Source-set-aware formal and exclusive autocatalysis predicates stated on exact hyperflows.
laws: exclusive autocatalysis excludes every food-supported hyperflow that produces x with zero input of x
exclusive autocatalysis includes a formal witness supported by the food set plus x
formal autocatalysis for x means 0 < inputFlow(x) < outputFlow(x)

capabilities.description: Thin theorems connecting exact hyperflows to the authenticated real incidence, stoichiometric-subspace, rank, and restricted-kernel APIs.
laws: stoichiometric action factors through the reused incidenceMatrix and composition matrix
the cast reaction-flow image lies in the reused stoichiometricSubspace
the reused restricted-kernel finrank identity is exposed without a parallel kernel representation
the reused stoichiometric-rank bound is exposed without a parallel rank definition

capabilities.description: Thin specialization of exact local spectral-crossing and periodic-orbit witnesses to the existing, unscaled Oregonator vector field, without deriving either witness from the other.
empirical_inputs: exact local eigenpair branch or invariant-curve return witness
laws: an Oregonator imaginary-eigenpair crossing witness yields only the advertised local spectral/transversality conclusion and no Hopf or periodic-orbit conclusion
an Oregonator periodic witness transfers to the general periodic-orbit certificate without changing time or state scaling
numerical initial concentrations or trajectories do not discharge exact certificate fields
the certificate vector field is definitionally or propositionally the reused Oregonator vectorField
source_refs: BIOMODELS-BIOMD0000000040:five-flux vectorField specification and oscillation scope guard

capabilities.description: A sealed-frontier obligation and theorem transporting an exact chemical periodic-orbit certificate to a physically isolated retained subsystem.
empirical_inputs: proof of no omitted reaction influence
laws: each retained reaction has no reactant or product support outside the retained species
restriction preserves positive period and nonconstancy on a retained coordinate
the frontier explicitly records that no omitted reaction changes a retained species
the sealed trajectory is pointwise governed by the restricted reused chemical vector field
transfer does not promote simulation, stochastic recurrence, stationarity, or path probability to deterministic oscillation

capabilities.description: A soundness-only exact separating-potential certificate for non-production, usable as the dual side of exclusive-autocatalysis checks without asserting a real-cone or integer Farkas completeness theorem.
laws: a valid dual certificate rules out every allowed-source hyperflow producing the target
certificates are proof inputs and are never trusted numerical-optimizer output
no integer-to-real equivalence or Farkas-style certificate-existence converse is claimed
the dual potential is exact integer data
the potential is nonnegative, vanishes on allowed sources, is positive at the target, and is nonincreasing along every reaction

capabilities.description: Exact Milo, Nghe, and support-minimal cycle predicates plus their defining implication lemmas.
laws: a Milo flow consumes and produces each selected species and is nondecreasing on all with strict increase on at least one
a support-minimal autocatalytic cycle is a support-minimal Milo flow
every Milo flow is formally autocatalytic for at least one selected species
every Nghe flow is a Milo flow
every used reaction in a Milo flow meets the selected species set
